goal: Map bubbles grow with member count instead of staying the same size
summary: Map bubbles now size by head count: clusterRadius(n) (90 + 70·√n) is both the space the layout reserves and the minimum drawn radius, members float freely inside it, and the outline is centered on the reserved anchor and eased (radius + center). Also: physics cooldown budgeted in ticks (720) instead of wall-clock 12s, so a throttled/background tab no longer freezes nodes in their spawn clumps; group labels show by on-screen bubble size instead of a fixed zoom cutoff.
commits: (this commit) Grow map bubbles with their head count
decisions: Bubble outline is centered on the layout anchor, not the member centroid: members now float freely within the bubble, so the centroid wanders and centroid-based outlines overlapped neighbours.
clusterRadius bumped from 70+60·√n to 90+70·√n so a loose pack at the collide spacing (~120 world units apart) actually fits; at the old size 40-person groups overflowed their reserved slot.
Anchor force only pulls the part of the distance beyond memberSpread (bubble radius minus pad and node radius), so bigger groups spread out to fill bigger bubbles.
cooldownTime=Infinity + cooldownTicks=720: wall-clock cooldown expired while a tab drew no frames (hidden pane / background tab), leaving nodes frozen in spawn clumps.
Labels: r*gs > 24 instead of gs > 0.18; the roomier layout put the initial fit zoom at ~0.178, which hid every name.
